accessNotes: The four product pages (1-Step, 2-Step, Instant Funding, Direct Funding) and the funding-program overview page rendered fully server-side and were readable - prices and rules tables came through cleanly. The Help Center (helpcenter.citytradersimperium.com) returns HTTP 403 to automated fetches and the /faqs/ path 404s, so FAQ-level detail (copy trading, account sharing, consistency, fee-refund mechanics) could NOT be verified. The Terms & Conditions PDF could not be parsed. Every price and rule below was read off the firm's own product pages; nothing here comes from aggregators or memory. One apparent conflict was found and resolved: the 1-Step page describes a high-watermark mechanism while the overview comparison table labels drawdowns tersely - a literal re-read of the comparison table's Max Drawdown row confirms both pages agree on '5% Trailing' for 1-Step. Prices were each confirmed by two independent reads of the same table.
